rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose everyday term for a pantyliner, rather than the broader sanitary-product terms.

example.english: I usually wear a liner, so I do not have to worry about staining my underwear.
example.traditional: 我通常會用護墊，咁就唔使成日擔心整污糟條底褲。
example.jyutping: ngo5 tung1 soeng4 wui5 jung6 wu6 din3 gam3 zau6 m4 sai2 seng4 jat6 daam1 sam1 zing2 wu1 zou1 tiu4 dai2 fu3

rows.note: Use this for a removable inner layer or insert, including a lining inside a container or item of clothing.

example.english: The liner of this bag can be removed and washed.
example.traditional: 呢個袋嘅內膽可以拆出嚟洗。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 doi6 ge3 noi6 daam2 ho2 ji5 caak3 ceot1 lai4 sai2

rows.note: Use this for a large passenger ship, especially one operating on a regular route; use 遠洋客輪 when emphasizing an ocean liner.

example.english: This liner travels between Hong Kong and Macao every day.
example.traditional: 呢艘客輪每日往返香港同澳門。
example.jyutping: ne1 sau1 haak3 leon4 mui5 jat6 wong5 faan2 hoeng1 gong2 tung4 ou3 mun4
